terms.meaning: a short code that lets someone join a crew

used_by: src/app/crews/CrewForms.tsx (the join form sends this request)

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Join a crew handler
sections.what: Reads the invite code from the body, asks the service to add the signed-in fan to the matching crew, and returns the result.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond matching the join form.
sections.watch_out: An old invite code stops working after a rotation, so a join can fail even when the fan typed the code correctly.

summary: Lets a signed-in fan join a crew using an invite code.
purpose: Gives fans a way in to a crew through a shared code.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the join form on the crew page.
how: 1) Confirms sign-in. 2) Checks the body holds an invite code in the expected shape. 3) Calls the join service and returns its result as JSON.
inputs: A POST with a JSON body holding an invite code. The caller comes from the session.
outputs: A JSON result from the crew service.
risks: The code shape is checked here, but whether the code is valid is only checked in the service.
debug: If joining fails, check the shape rule in the crews types and the join function in the crews service.
